description: Danxbot mantra (zero-context continuity: all work lives on cards or the plan; always the ideal, correct, zero-tech-debt solution) on SessionStart with no matcher, so it re-injects after compaction, plus a one-line pointer on UserPromptSubmit. Then the plugin skill load mandate for danxbot autonomous dispatch + worker runtime environment (SessionStart). Plus the always-on plan event bridge (DX-2784): an async SessionStart hook ensures one background process per session that relays the connected plan's dashboard events into the session inbox; SessionEnd stops it.
